notes: Ren'Py ships py/sh/exe launchers together; Linux path preferred over Wine when both exist. Compiled-only distributions without the renpy/ runtime dir are caught by the renpy-fallback row further down.

saves.source: renpy.py path_to_saves (no config.save_directory: <game>/saves; else %APPDATA%/RenPy/<dir>, ~/.renpy/<dir>, ~/Library/RenPy/<dir>) and renpy/savelocation.py init (adds <game>/saves); under Enginehost the 8.3 line's renpy.py path_to_saves (ENGINEHOST_SAVE_PATH/<save_directory>, else the game folder's name); all in the enginehost-renpy-plugin repo
